name: To Be Continued
desc:
From the Snow Realms to Siesta, Siracusa to Kazimierz,
seawater splashes from one end and soon turns to snowflakes on the other.
People are the same. Migration, contact, solitude, reunion.
Even after the camera lens moves away, life goes on.

infoUnlockDatas.storyDesc: Following the Snowcap Incident, Sciurus and Yucatan go to Victoria to represent the Browntails, and attempt to make a deal with a local magnate to rejuvenate their clan.

The day before leaving Shu for the capital, Liang Xun finally has a chance at a date with Ning Ciqiu for tea and a play in the mountains. Meanwhile, Du Yaoye, Zuo Le and others are about to set off on their own respective journeys.

Lungmen has welcomed a great number of outsiders. A wolf pack, a pack leader, a lone wolf... Slowly and quietly, they all find themselves shaped by the concrete jungle... until it is time for them to heed the call of the wild.

As planned, 'Roy the Lazurite' is about to get a face transplant and say goodbye to his old self. In the final moments of his old identity, Roy meets two young men also struggling to survive in Kazimierz's biggest city.
Guests arrive at Siesta on the eve of its imminent relocation, and Mayor Herman personally goes to greet them. A short meeting ensues between the two, both as leaders, and as fathers.

Jesselton was arrested after his cover as a prison guard was blown, and he became a typical inmate at the Mansfield State Prison. Despite the ridicule and harsh treatment he receives, he nonetheless finds his hope reignited by a letter.
